EntityLivingBase.overview: Abstract base for all living entities in 1.8.9, owning health, attributes, combat, potions and equipment state. Server-side logic broadcasts visual effects through WorldServer EntityTracker while persistent state syncs via DataWatcher slots. Client mirrors hurt, death, swing, pickup and potion color through status, animation and metadata packets.

methods.detail: Resets swingProgressInt and sets isSwingInProgress, then calls EntityTracker.sendToAllTrackingEntity with S0BPacketAnimation type 0 on WorldServer.
methods.name: swingItem
methods.purpose: Start arm-swing animation and broadcast to trackers

methods.detail: Server-only guard on worldObj.isRemote, then sends S0DPacketCollectItem with picked-up and collector entity IDs to all tracking clients.
methods.name: onItemPickup
methods.purpose: Broadcast pickup animation when collecting item, arrow or XP orb

methods.detail: Compares previousEquipment to getEquipmentInSlot each tick on server; on mismatch sends S04PacketEntityEquipment and reapplies attribute modifiers.
methods.name: onUpdate
methods.purpose: Per-tick equipment diff sync and arrow-count decay

methods.detail: Server-side damage pipeline with armor and potion reduction; calls worldObj.setEntityState byte 2 which tracker forwards as S19PacketEntityStatus.
methods.name: attackEntityFrom
methods.purpose: Apply damage, knockback and hurt broadcast

methods.detail: Awards score, drops loot on server, then setEntityState byte 3 so tracking clients play death sound and animation.
methods.name: onDeath
methods.purpose: Handle death drops and death animation broadcast

methods.detail: Byte 2 replays hurt animation and sound; byte 3 sets health zero and calls onDeath. Other IDs delegate to Entity super handler.
methods.name: handleStatusUpdate
methods.purpose: Client-side handler for hurt and death status bytes

methods.detail: Validates isPotionApplicable, combines or inserts into activePotionsMap, then marks potionsNeedUpdate so DataWatcher slots 7 and 8 sync via tracker metadata.
methods.name: addPotionEffect
methods.purpose: Add or combine active potion effect

methods.detail: Removes entry from activePotionsMap and calls onFinishedPotionEffect, which strips attribute modifiers and flags DataWatcher color update.
methods.name: removePotionEffect
methods.purpose: Remove potion effect and refresh metadata

methods.detail: Computes liquid color with PotionHelper and updates DataWatcher objects 7 and 8 plus invisibility flag; empty map resets metadata.
methods.name: updatePotionMetadata
methods.purpose: Recompute potion color and invisibility flags

methods.detail: Sets potionsNeedUpdate true; consumed in updatePotionEffects on server to push DataWatcher changes to tracking clients.
methods.name: markPotionsDirty
methods.purpose: Flag potion metadata for next tick sync

packet_usage.trigger: attackEntityFrom byte 2 and onDeath byte 3 via setEntityState
DataWatcher slots 6 health, 7 potion color, 8 ambient, 9 arrows via tracker

internal_fields.name: activePotionsMap
internal_fields.role: Maps potion ID to PotionEffect for ticking and NBT

internal_fields.name: potionsNeedUpdate
internal_fields.role: Dirty flag driving DataWatcher potion metadata refresh

internal_fields.name: previousEquipment
internal_fields.role: 5-slot cache used to detect S04 equipment changes

internal_fields.name: attributeMap
internal_fields.role: ServersideAttributeMap backing health, speed and modifiers

internal_fields.name: _combatTracker
internal_fields.role: Tracks recent damage sources for death messages

internal_fields.name: hurtTime/deathTime
internal_fields.role: Client-visible hurt and death animation timers

OldServerPinger.overview: Client-side multiplayer list pinger owned by server-selection GUI. Opens a temporary STATUS connection, parses MOTD, version, player count and favicon, then measures ping. Falls back to pre-1.7 MC|PingHost legacy ping when modern handshake fails.

methods.detail: Creates NetworkManager, installs anonymous INetHandlerStatusClient, sends handshake state STATUS plus C00PacketServerQuery; reply chain sends C01PacketPing.
methods.name: ping
methods.purpose: Start modern STATUS ping against a ServerData entry

methods.detail: Copies MOTD, protocol version, player sample, population string and favicon; records timestamp and sends C01PacketPing for latency.
methods.name: handleServerInfo
methods.purpose: Parse S00 server info into ServerData display fields

methods.detail: Subtracts stored send time from current time into server.pingToServer, then closes channel with Finished message.
methods.name: handlePong
methods.purpose: Compute latency and close ping channel

methods.detail: If query never completed, marks MOTD as cant-connect and delegates to tryCompatibilityPing for old servers.
methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.purpose: Handle failed modern ping and trigger legacy fallback

methods.detail: Writes MC|PingHost payload with host and port, parses NUL-split UTF-16BE 0xFF response into version, MOTD and player counts.
methods.name: tryCompatibilityPing
methods.purpose: Legacy 1.6 Beta-style 0xFE ping over raw Netty

methods.detail: Iterates pingDestinations, processes received packets while open, otherwise removes and checks disconnect reason.
methods.name: pingPendingNetworks
methods.purpose: Pump pending ping connections each client tick

methods.detail: Closes every open NetworkManager in pingDestinations with Cancelled message and removes it from the list.
methods.name: clearPendingNetworks
methods.purpose: Cancel all outstanding server-list pings

packet_usage.trigger: ping sends protocol 47 with STATUS next state
handleServerInfo updates MOTD and player list

internal_fields.name: pingDestinations
internal_fields.role: Synchronized list of active ping NetworkManagers

internal_fields.name: PING_RESPONSE_SPLITTER
internal_fields.role: NUL splitter with limit 6 for legacy ping parsing

internal_fields.name: logger
internal_fields.role: Logs ping failures and invalid favicon formats

internal_fields.name: field_175092_e
internal_fields.role: Ping send timestamp used for latency calc

internal_fields.name: field_147403_d
internal_fields.role: Marks query completion to gate fallback ping

NetHandlerStatusServer.overview: Server-side STATUS connection handler active between handshake and login. Answers a single server-list query with cached ServerStatusResponse and echoes one ping packet. Enforces one-query-per-connection then closes channel.

methods.detail: Stores MinecraftServer reference for status response and NetworkManager used to send replies and close channel.
methods.name: NetHandlerStatusServer
methods.purpose: Bind handler to server and connection

methods.detail: First C00PacketServerQuery sets handled and sends S00PacketServerInfo; duplicate queries close channel as already handled.
methods.name: processServerQuery
methods.purpose: Reply to status query with server info

methods.detail: Replies with S01PacketPong carrying client time, then closes channel with status-handled exit message.
methods.name: processPing
methods.purpose: Echo ping time and terminate status session

methods.detail: Intentionally empty because status connections carry no player state requiring cleanup.
methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.purpose: No-op disconnect hook for status phase

packet_usage.trigger: processPing echoes client time then disconnects

internal_fields.name: server
internal_fields.role: MinecraftServer source of MOTD and player counts

internal_fields.name: networkManager
internal_fields.role: Connection used to send replies and close

internal_fields.name: handled
internal_fields.role: One-shot guard rejecting duplicate queries

internal_fields.name: EXIT_MESSAGE
internal_fields.role: Shared disconnect text after status handled

ItemInWorldManager.overview: Server-side per-player survival, creative, adventure and spectator interaction controller. Validates dig timing, block harvesting, item use and block activation from NetHandlerPlayServer. Sends corrections and progress animations plus gamemode broadcasts to other players.

methods.detail: Applies capability preset, pushes abilities to owner, then broadcasts S38PacketPlayerListItem UPDATE_GAME_MODE to every client.
methods.name: setGameType
methods.purpose: Change gamemode and broadcast to all players

methods.detail: Creative calls tryHarvestBlock directly; survival starts isDestroyingBlock and calls world.sendBlockBreakProgress for S25 animation.
methods.name: onBlockClicked
methods.purpose: Begin survival dig or instant creative break

methods.detail: Advances curblockDamage, sends staged 0-10 break progress or -1 reset through world, harvests when hardness threshold reached.
methods.name: updateBlockRemoving
methods.purpose: Tick ongoing dig progress and finish harvest

methods.detail: If hardness above 0.7 finishes immediately with reset animation, else parks state in receivedFinishDiggingPacket for tick completion.
methods.name: blockRemoving
methods.purpose: Handle stop-digging packet mid-break

methods.detail: Clears isDestroyingBlock and sends block-break progress -1 for the tracked position to watching clients.
methods.name: cancelDestroyingBlock
methods.purpose: Abort dig and clear crack overlay

methods.detail: Enforces adventure canDestroy rules, plays AuxSFX, removes block; in creative sends S23PacketBlockChange so client matches server.
methods.name: tryHarvestBlock
methods.purpose: Remove block, drop loot and correct creative client

methods.detail: Calls useItemRightClick, restores stack size and damage in creative, and resyncs inventory container when not using item.
methods.name: tryUseItem
methods.purpose: Apply right-click item use with creative restore

methods.detail: Spectator only opens chests; others try onBlockActivated first unless sneaking, then delegates to stack.onItemUse.
methods.name: activateBlockOrUseItem
methods.purpose: Activate block or place held item

packet_usage.trigger: NetHandlerPlayServer dig and block-place drive these methods
sendBlockBreakProgress in dig start, tick and cancel

internal_fields.name: theWorld
internal_fields.role: Server world where block edits are applied

internal_fields.name: thisPlayerMP
internal_fields.role: Owning player for abilities and packet replies

internal_fields.name: gameType
internal_fields.role: Current survival, creative, adventure or spectator mode

internal_fields.name: isDestroyingBlock
internal_fields.role: Whether survival dig progress is active

internal_fields.name: receivedFinishDiggingPacket
internal_fields.role: Pending finish when stop arrived early

internal_fields.name: durabilityRemainingOnBlock
internal_fields.role: Last sent 0-10 crack stage to avoid resends
